title: A remote result that arrived before Misato's reply is in that reply
goal: Misato's final reply after a kaji.run reports the worker's outcome when its kaji.result is already recorded, instead of "queued"
acceptance: Test committed failing first across planner and store: a kaji.result recorded before the final reply makes that reply carry the result text (ran, refused or uncertain); with no result yet the reply keeps saying the result follows
Design: a read-only nervous RPC returns the sortie's kaji.result texts; the planner's finish appends them to Misato's reply for a sortie with a queued kaji.run step
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 after reading the path (S-B094 events: kaji.result recorded before misato.reply). Not a measurement.
